summary: Adds refit_time_ attribute measuring best-estimator refit duration, directly resolving the feature request in a minimal 3-line change. Correct approach; only minor nits (local import, docstring/attribute documentation not shown).

issues.description: import time placed inline inside method rather than at module top per PEP8/sklearn convention; harmless but stylistically inconsistent.
New public attribute refit_time_ should be documented in class docstring Attributes section (not visible in diff); maintainer would likely request adding it before merge.
Uses time.time() (wall clock) rather than time.process_time()/perf_counter; acceptable and matches use case of measuring elapsed refit time, but wall-clock can be affected by system load.
